about: The judge of one place audit. Facts are in the audit; the verdict and every threshold are here and in film-settings.json (place_* sections).

checks.text: not a quick trial
every visible object has a role (12 objects)
everything that is drawn is a mesh (or has a never role)
role timber.door: missing normal_map, roughness_variation, colour_variation, dirt, grime, weathering, wetness, cracks_and_chips, edge_wear.
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place finish (or the verb that makes it: surfaces, age, grow, damage); do not lower the requirement.

checks.text: 7 object(s) lack shape_damage.
no litter pieces on the ground (1 ground material(s) or object(s)).
no plants on the ground (1 ground material(s) or object(s)).
every layer amount is there and above its floor (state "dry")
nothing is switched off
0 normal map(s): Non-Color, tangent, wired, pointing the right way
every normal-mapped object has UVs, none mirrored beyond the limit
ground_mat: no displacement (role ground.earth needs it)
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place surfaces (it sets the method and grades or subdivides the mesh); roads: explainer-film-place roads.

checks.text: 1 part(s) floats: nothing carries it (gap over 5 mm).
checks.fix: move it onto a support or add one (a post under the beam, a footing under the post); seat things with seat_on_ground

checks.text: 18 size(s) fit the real-world facts

checks.where: wall_north, wall_south, wall_east, wall_west, door, floor_plank_1 and 4 more
checks.text: 83% of the objects are plain sharp-edged boxes (at most 15%).
checks.fix: run explainer-film-place surfaces (it bevels every hard-edged role) and damage; if they have run, these objects have a role the surfaces step does not bevel (ground, water, glass, plants, trees), so chamfer their meshes yourself (bmesh.ops.bevel) or give them a role that is not a plain box.

checks.text: no role has most of its objects as exact copies
triangles and scattered pieces are within the budgets
the scene has light
renderer EEVEE: nothing is lit: no lamp but the sun, no glowing material, no glow object (EEVEE is fine when the lights are off)
